findings.explanation: HOL4 gives only dest_var (Var x ty) = (x,ty). The argument is a constructor pattern, so Defn.non_wfrec_defn (Defn.sml:1182) uses Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition, i.e. new_specification with just that clause (Prim_rec.sml:259). There is no primitive definition with an ARB case, so the values on Const, Comb and Abs are unspecified and may differ. Lean's catch-all `_ => ARB` proves dest_var (Const n ty) = ARB, dest_var (Comb s t) = ARB and dest_var (Abs v t) = ARB, hence dest_var (Const n ty) = dest_var (Comb s t), which HOL4 leaves open. This also affects VSUBST and INST_CORE on Abs with a non-Var binder.
findings.repair:
noncomputable def dest_var : term → mlstring × type :=
  Classical.epsilon (fun f : term → mlstring × type => ∀ x ty, f (Var x ty) = (x, ty))
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntax

theorem dest_var_collapse (n : mlstring) (ty : type) (s t : term) :
    dest_var (term.Const n ty) = dest_var (term.Comb s t) := rfl

theorem dest_var_const_arb (n : mlstring) (ty : type) :
    dest_var (term.Const n ty) = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: !n ty0 s t. ?f:term -> mlstring # type. (!x ty. f (Var x ty) = (x,ty)) /\ f (Const n ty0) <> f (Comb s t)
